skills.skill: Identify whether a whole number is a perfect square
Determine the square root of a perfect square

misconceptions.pattern: Halves the number instead of finding the square root (answers √144 as 72), confusing the square root with division by two.
Assumes a large or even number must be a perfect square without checking for an integer factor that multiplies by itself.

strategies.intent: Look for a whole number that multiplies by itself to make n (1×1, 2×2, 3×3, …). If one exists, n is a perfect square and that number is its root; if none does by the time the product passes n, it is not.
